_why: A captured pi `get_entries` answer, written so that the order the entries were appended to the
file is NOT the order of the conversation. The straight path (a1..a4) was written first; the
leaf was then moved back to the first answer and the branch (b1, b2) was appended after it,
hanging off a2. leafId is on the branch, because that is what pi builds context from.
Anything that reads the list top-down marks a3/a4 as the conversation and misses b1/b2.
m1 is pi's own writing — a model change nobody asked the record to hold — and it is a root of
its own, off the path the leaf reads.
It is `get_entries` rather than `get_tree` because pi's tree answer nests one JSON level per
entry: a sixty-message conversation exceeds the bridge reader's recursion limit and the whole
record comes back unparseable. See docs/SESSION-TREE.md.
